ruleDefinitions.name: Portable Gpg.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "gpg.exe" from uncommon location. Often used by ransomware and loaders to decrypt/encrypt data.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg2\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "gpg\.exe" OR process_description = "GnuPG’s\ OpenPGP\ tool") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\GNU\\\\GnuPG\\\\bin\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\GnuPG\\ VS\\-Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\GnuPG\\\\bin\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Gpg4win\\\\bin\\\\.*")))
